(1) pipeline_replay_host_test.inc: map mode (TEGU_REPLAY_MAP_OUT, run with TEGU_AIR_PLAN=0) records 'record vsha fsha' of each pipeline; AIR mode (TEGU_REPLAY_MAP) keeps every record's pipeline and compiles each mali record's variant through tegu_render_generic_variant_compile (the device's draw-time path: AIR scope, TPC-MALI-1 entry 12); runtime-spec records skipped (prewarmed). (2) build_pipeline_pack.py: runs the map pass (discarded cache) then the real replay; oracle predicts AIR-plan first then m2v. (3) pipeline_cache_frontend.inc: TEGU_PSO_MISS mali gains cpu_ms (thread CPU) to separate waiting from computing on the next device run.
